typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		AMERIGROUP_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE as string,
		CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME as string,
		CAREGIVER_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		COUNTY as string,
		PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		SUB_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_AGE as string,
		NUMBER_ER_VISIT as string,
		SERVICE_DATE as string,
		NUMBER_INPATIENT_STAYS as string,
		TOP_DIAGNOSIS_CODE1 as string,
		TOP_DIAGNOSIS_CODE2 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT	 [AMERIGROUP_ID] 		,[MEMBER_LAST_NAME] 		,[MEMBER_FIRST_NAME] 		,[MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE] 		,[CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME] 		,[CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME] 		,[CAREGIVER_PHONE_NUMBER] 		,[MEMBER_DOB] 		,[COUNTY] 		,[PRODUCT_NAME] 		,[SUB_PRODUCT_NAME] 		,[ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_FIRST_NAME] 		,[ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_LAST_NAME] 		,[MEMBER_AGE]  		,[NUMBER_ER_VISIT] 		,[SERVICE_DATE] 		,[NUMBER_INPATIENT_STAYS] 		,[TOP_DIAGNOSIS_CODE1] 		,[TOP_DIAGNOSIS_CODE2]   FROM EXTRACT.GA_GOMO_TAY_PROGRAM_EXTRACT   ORDER BY [MEMBER_AGE]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableGAGOMOTAYPROGRAMEXTRACT
SourceTableGAGOMOTAYPROGRAMEXTRACT derive(AMERIGROUP_ID = AMERIGROUP_ID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		NUMBER_ER_VISIT as string,
		TOP_DIAGNOSIS_CODE1 as string,
		TOP_DIAGNOSIS_CODE2 as string,
		SERVICE_DATE as string,
		PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE as string,
		CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME as string,
		SUB_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_AGE as string,
		CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		CAREGIVER_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_LAST_NAME as string,
		AMERIGROUP_ID as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		NUMBER_INPATIENT_STAYS as string,
		COUNTY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		NUMBER_ER_VISIT,
		TOP_DIAGNOSIS_CODE1,
		TOP_DIAGNOSIS_CODE2,
		SERVICE_DATE,
		PRODUCT_NAME,
		MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE,
		CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME,
		SUB_PRODUCT_NAME,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_FIRST_NAME,
		MEMBER_AGE,
		CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME,
		CAREGIVER_PHONE_NUMBER,
		ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_LAST_NAME,
		AMERIGROUP_ID,
		MEMBER_DOB,
		NUMBER_INPATIENT_STAYS,
		COUNTY)) ~> TargetGoMoTayFile
